Name: EQUIP_PARAM_WEAPON_ST
Description:
Defines weapon types and each affinity.
Includes arrows and bolts. Responsible for scaling shown on certain consumables.
IDs not ending in a multiple of 100 are ignored.
Permitting affinities on a weapon without affinity rows at the correct IDs will result in the nearest 10000 being used.
SpEffects specified here can be modified by upgrades in ReinforceParamWeapon.

Fields.Name: Behavior Variation ID
Fields.Description: Chooses the attack moves this weapon performs. It selects a Behavior ID variant on top of the weapon's animation set. Change it only to a tested variant, or attacks may break.

Fields.Name: Sort ID
Fields.Description: Sets where this weapon sits in menus and lists. Lower numbers come first.

Fields.Name: Wandering Equip ID
Fields.Description: The weapon other players see on your wandering ghost instead of this one. This probably hides models their game cannot load.

Fields.Name: Weight (kg)
Fields.Description: How heavy the weapon is. Heavier gear raises Equip Load and slows your rolls.

Fields.Name: Equipment Weight Ratio
Fields.Description: Recovery speed after attacks and dodges. Higher values recover slower. 1 is slowest, 0 is fastest.

Fields.Name: Repair Value (souls)
Fields.Description: What a blacksmith charges to fully repair this weapon. A partly worn weapon costs less.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Value (souls)
Fields.Description: What each upgrade step costs. It never sets a shop price.

Fields.Name: Sell Value (souls)
Fields.Description: The price Kingseeker Frampt pays for this weapon. That may be its only use, but it is unproven.

Fields.Name: Correction: STR
Fields.Description: How much Strength raises this weapon's damage. Higher values mean stronger scaling, shown as a letter grade.

Fields.Name: Correction: DEX
Fields.Description: How much Dexterity raises this weapon's damage. Higher values mean stronger scaling, shown as a letter grade.

Fields.Name: Correction: INT
Fields.Description: How much Intelligence raises this weapon's damage. Higher values mean stronger scaling, shown as a letter grade.

Fields.Name: Correction: FTH
Fields.Description: How much Faith raises this weapon's damage. Higher values mean stronger scaling, shown as a letter grade.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Physical (%)
Fields.Description: How much physical damage a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Magic (%)
Fields.Description: How much magic damage a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Fire (%)
Fields.Description: How much fire damage a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Lightning (%)
Fields.Description: How much lightning damage a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: SpEffect on Hit: 1
Fields.Description: Extra effect this weapon inflicts on enemies it hits, such as bleed or poison. None means a plain hit. Upgrades can replace it.

Fields.Name: SpEffect on Hit: 2
Fields.Description: Extra effect this weapon inflicts on enemies it hits, such as bleed or poison. None means a plain hit. Upgrades can replace it.

Fields.Name: SpEffect on Hit: 3
Fields.Description: Extra effect this weapon inflicts on enemies it hits, such as bleed or poison. None means a plain hit. Upgrades can replace it.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect: 1
Fields.Description: Bonus this weapon grants you while equipped. None means no bonus.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect: 2
Fields.Description: Bonus this weapon grants you while equipped. None means no bonus.

Fields.Name: Resident SpEffect: 3
Fields.Description: Bonus this weapon grants you while equipped. None means no bonus.

Fields.Name: Upgrade Material ID
Fields.Description: Which titanite each upgrade step needs. Pick the set that matches the upgrade path you want.

Fields.Name: Source ID: +0

Fields.Name: Damage Adjustment: Demon (x)
Fields.Description: Extra damage against demons. 1.1 adds 10%, and 1 means no bonus.

Fields.Name: Damage Adjustment: Divine (x)
Fields.Description: Extra damage against divine-weak enemies. Divine weapons also stop skeletons reviving. 1 means no bonus.

Fields.Name: Damage Adjustment: Occult (x)
Fields.Description: Extra damage against occult-weak enemies. 1.1 adds 10%, and 1 means no bonus.

Fields.Name: Damage Adjustment: Darkwraith (x)
Fields.Description: Extra damage against abyssal enemies like Darkwraiths. 1.1 adds 10%, and 1 means no bonus.

Fields.Name: Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the Vagrant this weapon may become. -1 spawns none, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Good Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the extra creature a Good Vagrant may bring. -1 drops nothing, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Evil Vagrant: Item Lot ID
Fields.Description: The reward roll for the creature an Evil Vagrant may bring. -1 drops nothing, and 0 grants nothing.

Fields.Name: Model ID
Fields.Description: Which 3D model the weapon uses. Match it to the weapon's type or it looks wrong.

Fields.Name: Icon ID
Fields.Description: Which inventory icon this weapon shows.

Fields.Name: Durability
Fields.Description: The durability a found weapon starts with. Fighting lowers it, and at zero the weapon breaks.

Fields.Name: Max Durability
Fields.Description: The highest durability a repair can restore.

Fields.Name: Damage: Throw Attack
Fields.Description: Probably helps you break free from enemy grabs. The effect is unproven, so copy a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Parry Damage Duration (frames)
Fields.Description: How long a parry attempt stays active. The animation can only shorten it, never stretch it.

Fields.Name: Damage: Physical
Fields.Description: Physical damage before stat scaling and upgrades add more.

Fields.Name: Damage: Magic
Fields.Description: Magic damage before stat scaling and upgrades add more.

Fields.Name: Damage: Fire
Fields.Description: Fire damage before stat scaling and upgrades add more.

Fields.Name: Damage: Lightning
Fields.Description: Lightning damage before stat scaling and upgrades add more.

Fields.Name: Damage: Stamina
Fields.Description: Stamina damage this weapon deals to a blocking target. Higher values drain more stamina through the guard and break it sooner. It does nothing when the target is not blocking.

Fields.Name: Damage: Poise
Fields.Description: Poise damage each hit deals. Higher values stagger foes sooner.

Fields.Name: Poise
Fields.Description: May grant Poise during your own attacks. It looks unused, so changing it may do nothing.

Fields.Name: Horizontal Guard Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: May set how wide a block catches attacks. It looks unused, so changing it may do nothing.

Fields.Name: Guard Stability (%)
Fields.Description: How much blocking drains your stamina. Higher values drain less, so you block longer.

Fields.Name: Reinforcement Type ID
Fields.Description: Which upgrade table this weapon follows to +5 or +15. It sets the stat gains per level.

Fields.Name: Achievement ID
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may link this weapon to an achievement. Leave it unless you test it.

Fields.Name: Sequential Achievement ID
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may order this weapon in an achievement checklist. Leave it unless you test it.

Fields.Name: Critical Hit %
Fields.Description: Probably sets backstab and riposte damage. The exact math is unproven, so copy a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Ammunition Distance %
Fields.Description: Extra range this weapon gives arrows and bolts. 0 means no change.

Fields.Name: Model Category
Fields.Description: Unknown. It tags the model type this weapon uses. Match a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Model Gender Category
Fields.Description: Unknown. It tags the model gender this weapon uses. Match a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Weapon Category
Fields.Description: Partly sets what kind of weapon this is. Ranged weapons use it to pick arrows or bolts. Copy a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Weapon Animation Set
Fields.Description: Which set of attack animations this weapon uses. Pick a tested set or attacks break.

Fields.Name: Guard Animation Set
Fields.Description: Which block animation this weapon uses. Copy a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Attack Presentation: Material
Fields.Description: Hit sparks and sounds this weapon makes. Pick one that fits the weapon.

Fields.Name: Defense Presentation: Material
Fields.Description: Clash sounds and sparks when this weapon blocks. Pick one that fits the weapon.

Fields.Name: Defence Presentation: Particles
Fields.Description: Sparks shown when this weapon blocks. Pick one that fits the weapon.

Fields.Name: Damage Correction Graph
Fields.Description: Which scaling graph turns stats into bonus damage. 0 fits Strength and Dexterity weapons, 1 fits Intelligence and Faith ones.

Fields.Name: Special Attribute
Fields.Description: May set the hit effects and death animations this weapon causes. Fire burns foes, and lightning zaps them.

Fields.Name: Weapon Override Animation Set
Fields.Description: Extra animations that replace parts of the base set. Some weapon types use it for their whole moveset.

Fields.Name: Weapon Idle Animation Set: 1H
Fields.Description: Base motions used when held one-handed. Copy a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Weapon Idle Animation Set: 2H
Fields.Description: Base motions used when held two-handed. Copy a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Requirement: STR
Fields.Description: Strength needed to wield this weapon well. Less means weak swings. Two hands count as 50% more Strength.

Fields.Name: Requirement: DEX
Fields.Description: Dexterity needed to wield this weapon well. Less means weak swings.

Fields.Name: Requirement: INT
Fields.Description: Intelligence needed to wield this weapon well. Less means weak swings.

Fields.Name: Requirement: FTH
Fields.Description: Faith needed to wield this weapon well. Less means weak swings.

Fields.Name: STR over Start Value
Fields.Description: Unknown. It may mark where extra Strength stops helping. Copy a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Parry Attack
Fields.Description: The base parry attack damage value. Applied to the enemy parry defense value.

Fields.Name: Parry Defense
Fields.Description: The base parry defense value. Compared against enemy parry attack value.

Fields.Name: Base Repel: Defense
Fields.Description: How well blocks bounce enemy attacks back. Weak hits bounce off instead of hurting you.

Fields.Name: Base Repel: Attack
Fields.Description: How well attacks punch through blocks without bouncing. Weak swings bounce off strong blocks.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption Invalidation (%)
Fields.Description: How much attacks ignore enemy blocks. -100 cuts through fully, and 0 is normal.

Fields.Name: Guard Damage Level
Fields.Description: Which guard animation plays when a hit lands.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Slash (%)
Fields.Description: How much slash damage a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Strike (%)
Fields.Description: How much strike damage a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption: Thrust (%)
Fields.Description: How much thrust damage a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Poison
Fields.Description: How much poison buildup a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Toxic
Fields.Description: How much toxic buildup a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Bleed
Fields.Description: How much bleed buildup a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Guard Absorption %: Curse
Fields.Description: How much curse buildup a block stops. 100 stops it all.

Fields.Name: Is Animation Changed by Durability
Fields.Description: Switches animations as durability falls. Spell tools use this as casts run out.

Fields.Name: Two-Hand Wield
Fields.Description: Lets you wield this weapon two-handed. Off locks it to one hand.

Fields.Name: Enables Guard
Fields.Description: Lets this weapon block when held in the left hand.

Fields.Name: Enables Parry
Fields.Description: Lets this weapon parry when held in the left hand.

Fields.Name: Enables Magic
Fields.Description: Casts the readied sorcery when you attack. Turn it on for catalysts.

Fields.Name: Enables Pyromancy
Fields.Description: Casts the readied pyromancy when you attack. Turn it on for flames.

Fields.Name: Enables Miracles
Fields.Description: Casts the readied miracle when you attack. Turn it on for talismans.

Fields.Name: Enables Vow Magic
Fields.Description: Unknown. No weapon in the game uses covenant magic. Leave it off unless you test it.

Fields.Name: Menu Display: Normal
Fields.Description: Shows Normal on the weapon's menu card. It changes nothing about damage.

Fields.Name: Menu Display: Strike
Fields.Description: Shows Strike on the weapon's menu card. It changes nothing about damage.

Fields.Name: Menu Display: Slash
Fields.Description: Shows Slash on the weapon's menu card. It changes nothing about damage.

Fields.Name: Menu Display: Thrust
Fields.Description: Shows Thrust on the weapon's menu card. It changes nothing about damage.

Fields.Name: Is Buffable
Fields.Description: Lets resins and weapon spells buff this weapon. Elemental paths usually forbid it.

Fields.Name: Apply Humanity Correction
Fields.Description: Adds bonus damage from held humanity, up to 10. Chaos weapons use this.

Fields.Name: Disable Weapon Job Change
Fields.Description: Stops this weapon reverting to its base form. Ascended weapons stay ascended.

Fields.Name: Is Dark Hand
Fields.Description: Unknown. It marks this as a Dark Hand. Copy the Dark Hand's value.

Fields.Name: Is Anti-Ghost Weapon
Fields.Description: Lets this weapon strike ghosts with no curse needed.

Fields.Name: Job Category
Fields.Description: Which ascension family this weapon belongs to. The blacksmith offers upgrades from that family.

Fields.Name: Is Dragon-Hunter Weapon
Fields.Description: Unknown. It marks this as a dragonslayer weapon. Copy a similar weapon.

Fields.Name: Can Deposit
Fields.Description: Lets you store this weapon in the Bottomless Box at bonfires.

Fields.Name: Is Drop Disabled in Multiplayer
Fields.Description: Stops other players picking this weapon up if dropped online.

Fields.Name: Sort ID (Obsolete)
Fields.Description: Unknown. An old ordering number the game probably ignores.

Fields.Name: Level Sync Correction ID
Fields.Description: Used when password co-op syncs a strong guest down to the host. The exact values are unproven, so copy a similar weapon.
